mapper.select: SELECT PMST, PMKY, PMCO, PMNM, PMV1, PMV2, PMV3,PMV4,PMV5, TO_CHAR(inserttimestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS inserttimestamp, TO_CHAR(updatetimestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatetimestamp FROM PARAMETER WHERE PMST = 'CONFIG' AND PMKY = 'PUBLIC' AND PMCO='accessToken'

SELECT PMST, PMKY, PMCO, PMNM, PMV1, PMV2, PMV3,PMV4,PMV5, TO_CHAR(inserttimestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS inserttimestamp, TO_CHAR(updatetimestamp,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updatetimestamp FROM PARAMETER
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CMWA_USER_TERMS_LOG TG WHERE TG.CMFUSERID = #{cmfUserId} AND TG.FUNDCODE = #{fundId} AND TG.PERIOD = #{period}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CMWA_USER_OPERATE_LOG(ID, CMFUSERID, LOGIN_CHANNEL, TYPE, CREATETIME, UPDATETIME, FUNDID, PERIOD) VALUES( SEQ_USER_OPERATE_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{map.cmfuserid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{map.loginChannel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{map.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{map.fundId}, #{map.period})
